name: KREWELLA — One Life (Supernova Anthem)
notes: Krewella — One Life (86.6 half-time / 173.2 DnB BPM, downbeat offset 0.032s). Every section boundary lands on an extracted downbeat. Drop 1 (77.62s) evolves every 4 bars (Supernova Wings → DnB Scanner Whip → Molten Bounce → Bar-40 1-bar Fakeout Pocket at 110.73s → 3-bar Encore Slam at 113.48s). Drop 2 (157.28s) hits out of a 2-beat pitch blackout into Supernova Wings, pivots at Bar 63 (173.83s), peaks in an 8-bar Golden Euphoria climax (176.59s), opens into a pure ungated Aurora Harmonic Soar at Bar 72 (198.66s), and slams a 4-bar finale (204.46s). Hue bulbs are 100% flicker-safe (inertia-backed audio_mod, spatial wing stepping, per-bar expression whips); all 1/8 & 1/16 shutters and snare rolls run exclusively on the WLED steel strip.
